profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a non-profit, open-source foundation that develops and distributes Blender, a free and open-source 3D creation software. The software covers modeling, rigging, animation, rendering, camera and object tracking, Grease Pencil drawing, and VFX work, and it exposes a Python API that allows users to build or install community add-ons. The foundation also operates Blender Studio, which produces training content and original film projects, including an announced feature film project called OVERGROWN. Blender is a member of ASWF, Khronos, Linux Foundation, and OIN, and the project receives hardware support from AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the site tracks a product category called Blender AI Add-ons, described as third-party plugins that bring AI capabilities into the Blender environment, run with local processing, and carry open-source licenses, with model provenance varying by individual plugin. An upcoming release, Blender 5.2 LTS, is noted on the site for a Cycles Texture Cache feature that improves memory efficiency when rendering scenes with many image textures, and it will ship with an Online Essentials Asset Library for procedural materials. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the held data for this organization.
